entity.description:
The Azores is an autonomous region of Portugal in the North Atlantic Ocean. They consist of an archipelago of nine volcanic islands, with the capital being Ponta Delgada. The islands are known for their unique biodiversity as well as coastal regions and green pastures.

John Hammond initially planned on building another Jurassic Park Europe in the Azores after the success of Jurassic Park in Isla Nublar. However, the Nublar park failed due to the Isla Nublar Incident (1993), hence cancelling the construction of Jurassic Park Europe. The list of prehistoric species to be cloned for the park is currently unknown.
